---
name: requirements-engineering
description: Use at the start of a new feature or task, before writing code, to clarify what should be built and define acceptance criteria.
---
# Requirements engineering

1. Restate the goal of the task in one or two sentences.
2. Ask clarifying questions about anything ambiguous (inputs, outputs, data sources, edge cases, constraints). Do not assume.
3. Write user stories in the form: "As a <user>, I want <goal> so that <reason>."
4. For each story, write testable acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then).
5. List what is out of scope.
6. Note dependencies, risks and open questions.
7. Get confirmation from the user before moving on to implementation.

Output: a short markdown spec with Goal, User stories, Acceptance criteria, Out of scope, Open questions.
